title: Performance analysis and debugging of MPI programs
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: No independent audio verification; source reconciliations are grounded in original slide frames and primary technical contracts.
Historical mpiP 3.1.2 run was interpreted from displayed source frames; it was not reproduced locally. Rounded sums differ from exact underlying values.
MUST homepage requests timed out; the official RWTH 2022 project article was opened and used for the name and runtime scope. MUST was not run.
Vampir and BSC tool pages were inaccessible; these names are retained only as source-lecture mentions, with no independently asserted product capability or executed GUI.
No mpiP, Scalasca, TAU, MUST, Intel trace analyzer or graphical trace viewer execution is claimed. The minimal PMPI wrapper is an original construction.
No inter-node, InfiniBand, shared-memory-transport, actual scheduler or parallel-filesystem experiment was performed.
NTFS debugger_attach_fifo warning persists. Separate child-process batch GDB succeeded; external attachment and Valgrind vgdb bridge are not established.

Memcheck application access oracle disables reporting around MPI runtime calls and excludes leak classes from exit status; XML leak records retained. No leak-free or unrestricted clean Memcheck claim.

lecture_corrections.source: W11L1 synchronization discussion and W11L2 collective slide
lecture_corrections.correction: Blocking collectives are not generic barriers; MPI4.1 §7.1 defines local completion.
GDB thread selection applies to controlled inferiors; it does not automatically traverse all MPI ranks.
MUST is Marmot Umpire Scalable Tool in the official project description, not MPI Unit Test.
4.4e3 milliseconds is 4.4 accumulated rank-seconds; MPI%=55.40 is a percentage, not seconds. Public text attributes values to the slide and does not allege an audio error.
